A Letter From Abdul Momin

A Birthday Letter For You 💌

Meri Pyari Hooriya, ❤️

Aaj ka din aapke liye bohat special hai. Meri dua hai ke Allah Pak aapki zindagi ko hamesha khushiyon, sukoon, mohabbat aur barkaton se bhar de. 🤲🏻✨

Aapki har dua qubool ho, har khwab poora ho aur aap hamesha isi tarah muskurati rahen. Allah aapko har buri nazar se mehfooz rakhe aur har qadam par kamyabi ata farmaye. 🌸

Aapki zindagi ka ye naya saal beautiful memories, happiness aur success lekar aaye. Ameen. 🤍

Happy Birthday, Hooriya! 🎂💗
